title: Diffing rule 1: new type, new subtree

slides.say: When React compares two elements of different types, it does not try to diff them at all.
Div became span. React tears down the old tree, destroying the old Counter and its state, and builds a new one from scratch.
Same DOM type? React keeps the same DOM node and only updates the changed attribute, here class name.

slides.text: Same component type? The instance stays, so state is kept, and React recurses into children.
slides.say: Same component type? The instance stays, its state is kept, and React updates the props and recurses into the children.
